Recognition of financial investment"}, {"bbox": [127, 163, 242, 178], "category": "Section-header", "text": "a. Trading securities"}, {"bbox": [127, 184, 666, 215], "category": "Text", "text": "Trading securities are investments in purchasing securities and other financial instruments for trading purposes (holding with the purpose of price increase to sell for profit), include:"}, {"bbox": [127, 222, 365, 237], "category": "Text", "text": "- Stocks and bonds listed on the stock market;"}, {"bbox": [127, 243, 666, 273], "category": "Text", "text": "- Other securities and financial instruments such as commercial paper, forward contracts, swap contracts..."}, {"bbox": [127, 280, 666, 310], "category": "Text", "text": "Trading securities are recorded at original cost. The time of recording trading securities is the time when the investor has ownership."}, {"bbox": [127, 317, 666, 377], "category": "Text", "text": "**Provisions for devaluation of trading securities:** are the value loss may occur when there is a solid evidence that the market value of the securities hold by the Group for trading purposes has decreased compared to the book value. The provision or reversal of this provision is made at the time of preparing the Consolidated Financial Statement and is recorded in the financial expenses of the period."}, {"bbox": [127, 392, 305, 407], "category": "Section-header", "text": "b. Held-to-maturity investments"}, {"bbox": [127, 413, 666, 474], "category": "Text", "text": "This investment does not reflect bonds and debt instruments held for trading purposes with the aim of earning profit. Held-to-maturity investments include term deposits, treasury bills, promissory notes, bonds, preference shares that the issuer must redeem at a certain time in the future, loans held to maturity for the purpose of earning periodic interest and other investments held to maturity."}, {"bbox": [127, 480, 666, 584], "category": "Text", "text": "**Provision for diminution in value of held to maturity investments:** For investments held to maturity that have not been provisioned in accordance with the law, Group must assess the recoverability. In cases where there is solid evidence that a part or the entire investment may not be recoverable, the loss must be recorded in financial expenses during the period. The provision or reversal of this provision is made at the time of preparing the Consolidated financial statements. In cases where the loss cannot be reliably determined, the investment is not recorded as a reduction and the recoverability of the investment is explained in the Notes to the Consolidated Financial Statements."}, {"bbox": [127, 599, 417, 614], "category": "Section-header", "text": "c. Investments in equity instruments of other entities"}, {"bbox": [127, 614, 666, 644], "category": "Text", "text": "Investments in equity instruments of other entities but without control or joint control, without significant influence over the investee."}, {"bbox": [94, 658, 272, 673], "category": "Section-header", "text": "5. Trade account receivables"}, {"bbox": [127, 680, 666, 711], "category": "Text", "text": "All receivables must be recorded detail by aging, by each client and in original currency if any and others details depending on the management request of the Group."}, {"bbox": [127, 718, 277, 733], "category": "Text", "text": "Classification of receivables:"}, {"bbox": [127, 739, 666, 785], "category": "Text", "text": "- Trade receivables: commercial receivables arising from purchase-sale transactions between DIC Group and buyers such as sales, service provision, disposal of assets, export sales proceeds of the consignor through the consignee;"}, {"bbox": [127, 791, 653, 806], "category": "Text", "text": "- Other receivables: receivables of a non-commercial nature, not related to purchase-sale transactions."}, {"bbox": [127, 813, 497, 828], "category": "Text", "text": "Classify receivables when preparing Consolidated financial statements:"}, {"bbox": [127, 835, 666, 867], "category": "Text", "text": "- Receivables with a remaining collection period of no more than 12 months or within one business production cycle are classified as short-term."}, {"bbox": [372, 975, 386, 989], "category": "Page-footer", "text": "16"}]
